title: clausena san-ki
intro: Clausena san-ki, commonly known as the Sansho pepper or Japanese pepper, is a type of plant in the Rutaceae family, native to Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Clausena san-ki include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Clausena san-ki include its use as a traditional remedy for stomach issues, fever reduction, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Clausena san-ki include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
